title: Layer tooling integration
description: One tool or service a layer can use. Each layer lists its integrations in <layer>/tooling/integrations.json. Credentials are named, never stored. Entries under interface/ are interfaces, not integrations: they must reach at least three of the five other layers (EE-038) (schema/check-integrations.mjs). Knowledge integrations with a connector are the connector registry (EE-037): a venture's knowledge/sources.json names them by id.

role.description: What the layer uses it for, in a few words

interfaces.description: How agents and code reach it

reach.description: Interface layer only: the other layers a person can work in through it, in one session. At least three of the five.

interface_kind.description: Interface layer only: an agent harness (built around an AI agent's loop, tools and files) or a custom workbench built for the system or a venture.

reason.description: Why it is in use, a candidate, or rejected

adapter.description: Path to the skill, MCP config or script that wires it in, when one exists

connector.description: Knowledge layer only: the module that implements the connector contract (knowledge/connectors/contract.mjs) for this integration, so a venture's knowledge/sources.json can keep records in it (EE-037)

module.description: Path from the repository root; it exports connect(options). Naive ships only connectors that work offline and name no vendor (knowledge/connectors/); an app that hosts Naive registers any other with registerConnector in knowledge/connectors/index.mjs (EE-041)

writes.description: The write modes it supports; the first is its default

options.description: The source options it takes, besides id and writes

eval.description: The command that runs the contract evals against it
